- **ev-25-02** (`dependency_latency`, value 4.312, same window) — downstream latency elevated
- **ev-25-03** (`error_logs`, value 4.343, same window) — error rate elevated
- No causal graph, no dependency graph nodes, no registered gaps yet; all three evidence items are UNREVIEWED synthetic eval projections with redacted dimensions; no temporal ordering or fd time-series is present.
